column1: # The (ら)れる voice table (spec poc08/spec/voice.md, VC-*): hand-written rows over the named features of a voice
# point (Features in src/decide.cpp) and 0.7.x's own reading (p075=<class>, NONE when it shows none). The most
# specific row that holds decides (verb lemma conditions first, then the number of conditions; the earlier row
# wins a tie); its class overrides 0.7.x's when they differ. @default = the verb's default reading in
# voice/verbs.tsv (the passive for a verb outside it); KEEP keeps 0.7.x's. Derived features from verbs.tsv:
# intable, allow=<class>, vdefault=<class>, p075bad (0.7.x's reading is one the verb does not allow). A condition
# is a feature (neg), a feature with one of the values (vlem=見る|見える) or any value (obj=*), or ! before either.

column7: note
0.7.x shows no reading: the verb's default reading (VC-9), the passive for a verb outside the table
友達に逃げられた: a person before に is the agent of a passive

column3: p075=NONE|OTHER aux=られる n1=ない no_dat allow=POTENTIAL !allow=SPONTANEOUS
column7: 逃げられない: an ichidan られる before a negative, no agent: the potential

column3: p075=NONE|OTHER aux=られる n1=ない no_dat !intable
column7: 鍵が開けられない: as above, for a verb outside the table
0.7.x's reading is one the verb does not allow (呼ばれる as a potential): the verb's default
agent に: the passive

column3: p075bad aux=られる n1=ない no_dat allow=POTENTIAL !allow=SPONTANEOUS
column7: before a negative, no agent: the potential
見られてる: a potential takes no affirmative ている, so られている is the passive

column3: aux=られる n1=て n2=居る p075=POTENTIAL|NONE|OTHER !neg
column7: 見られている: as above
a person before に is the agent of a passive
女に見初められた: a person before に and no negative: the passive

column3: aux=られる n1=ない no_dat p075=PASSIVE !n2=様 !allow=SPONTANEOUS
column7: 決められない: an ichidan られる before a negative with no agent: the potential

column3: subj@person.higher no_dat polite !subj=私|僕|俺|あたし|わたし|わたくし|自分|我|我々|俺達|私達|僕達 !topic=私|僕|俺|あたし|わたし|わたくし|自分|我|我々|俺達|私達|僕達
column7: 神様が来られました: a superior subject, polite speech, no agent
なされる is the respectful する
品種改良がなされた: なされる with a subject that is no person is the passive of なす
申される, 参られた: (ら)れる on a humble verb is respect (old speech)
おられる is the respectful いる
いられない: いられる is the potential of いる
有罪とされた: とされる is the passive
と思われている: others think so (passive), not it seems
考えられない: cannot think (the potential)
考えられる可能性: conceivable (the potential before a noun)
信じられない: unbelievable (the potential)
来られない: cannot come
先生に叱られた: a godan れる with a person before に is the passive, never the potential
